mintAuthority.summary: FUSD's reviewed EVM deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, Sonic, and Monad share an issuer-administered uncapped gateway and zero-delay ProxyAdmin. The cataloged Solana mint has a verified 1-of-3 SPL Token multisig, but its liability identity is disputed: on-chain metadata names FinChain Dollar LP / FUSDLP, and issuer FUSD and FUSDLP pages both list that mint. Existing Solana control exposure is retained pending identity adjudication, not presented as an unambiguous FUSD native deployment. CCIP pools and TokenBridgeSender remain bridge machinery reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk.

review.evidence: Historical role enumeration at Ethereum block 25770551, Avalanche 92978950, Sonic 77632056, and Monad 96606403 confirms the local gateway is a token MINTER_ROLE member on all four EVM deployments and that the shared FinChain EOA is the sole token and gateway DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder on each. The verified FUSDGateway zero-destination branch is an admin-only arbitrary local mint, so native EVM issuance remains unbounded; CCIP pools and the current TokenBridgeSender implementation are bridge machinery documented under bridgeRouteRisk. Proxy-slot and owner reads at Ethereum 25770580, Avalanche 92979277, Sonic 77632253, and Monad 96607753 resolve the shared zero-delay ProxyAdmin and the reviewed token, gateway, and sender implementations. The 2026-09-21 Solana review treated the cataloged SPL mint as FUSD. Current finalized reads on 2026-10-01 confirm its 1-of-3 authority but reveal FinChain Dollar LP / FUSDLP metadata, while both issuer token pages list the same address. Native FUSD liability attribution is therefore unresolved, and existing adverse exposure is retained pending identity adjudication. Issuer reserve reconciliation and claimed prudential Bermuda supervision are not independently verified reserve assurance or a current regulator authorization finding.
